nodes.label: Observational Analysis V2
nodes.content: Statistical analysis of audio feature predictors for SyncNet lip-sync quality. Correlates 52 audio features (MFCC, spectral, energy, pitch) against SyncD and SyncC across 447 scored rows. Top SyncD predictors: mfcc_3_std (Spearman r=-0.3363), mfcc_10_mean (r=-0.2628), mfcc_11_mean (r=-0.2298). Top SyncC predictors: spec_centroid_std (r=-0.3902), onset_mean (r=+0.3486), mfcc_2_mean (r=+0.3107). Includes LASSO regression (R²=0.6028, 43 non-zero features), Random Forest (R²=0.9417), PCA (PC1=25.8%, PC2=18.3%), within-provider partial correlation, loudness normalization effect analysis (LUFS vs original), and provider feature profiles.

nodes.label: Loudness Normalization Effect
nodes.content: Analysis of LUFS-normalized vs original audio within same TTS models (F5-TTS, Higgs TTS 3, ChatTTS, IndexTTS2, GSV-TTS, Fish S2 Pro). Loudnorm to -23 LUFS has inconsistent effects: improves SyncD for F5-TTS (-0.166) and Higgs (-0.280) but degrades it for Fish S2 Pro (+0.890) and IndexTTS2 (+0.236). Dynamic compression (LRA=7, TP=-1) can smooth phoneme boundaries, reducing lip-sync quality.

nodes.label: Audio Feature-SyncNet Correlation
nodes.content: Statistical analysis correlating 52 audio features against SyncD and SyncC. Top SyncD predictors (negative=better): mfcc_3_std (r=-0.3363), mfcc_10_mean (r=-0.2628), mfcc_11_mean (r=-0.2298). Top SyncC predictors: spec_centroid_std (r=-0.3902), onset_mean (r=+0.3486), mfcc_2_mean (r=+0.3107). Random Forest achieves R²=0.9417 with mfcc_3_std as most important feature (0.1016 importance). LASSO selects 43 non-zero features (R²=0.6028).

nodes.label: SyncNet Scored Dataset
nodes.content: Evaluation dataset: 447 scored rows with 52 audio features, 447 clean rows after preprocessing. Used for observational analysis correlating audio features against SyncD and SyncC metrics. Contains multiple TTS providers (f5_tts, fish_audio, dashscope_vc, qwen3, higgs_tts, indextts2, gsv_tts, chattts) with provider-level feature profiles.

nodes.label: LASSO Regression for SyncD
nodes.content: LASSO regression for SyncD feature selection: best alpha=0.003967, R²=0.6028, 43 non-zero features selected. Top coefficients: mfcc_2_mean (-0.3354, better SyncD), spec_flatness_std (+0.3087, worse SyncD), onset_std (+0.3018, worse SyncD), spec_rolloff (-0.2980, better SyncD).

nodes.label: Random Forest for SyncD
nodes.content: Random Forest regression for SyncD: R²=0.9417 training. Top-3 importance: mfcc_3_std (0.1016), mfcc_4_std (0.0729), mfcc_11_mean (0.0524). MFCC features dominate importance rankings for predicting lip-sync quality.

nodes.label: PCA Feature Space Analysis
nodes.content: PCA on 52 audio features colored by SyncD quantile: PC1 explains 25.8% variance, PC2 18.3%. PC1 top loadings: mfcc_13_std (+0.2472), mfcc_2_mean (-0.2416), f0_std (+0.2403). PC2 top loadings: energy_env_smoothness (+0.2651), spec_flux (+0.2644), rms (+0.2573).
